doc.brief: Describes which edge of a widget a certain feature is positioned at.
doc.md:
Describes which edge of a widget a certain feature is positioned at.

For examples, see the tabs of a [`Notebook`](xref:gtk:Notebook), or the label
of a [`Scale`](xref:gtk:Scale).

bottom.brief: The feature is at the bottom edge.
bottom.md: The feature is at the bottom edge.

left.brief: The feature is at the left edge.
left.md: The feature is at the left edge.

right.brief: The feature is at the right edge.
right.md: The feature is at the right edge.

top.brief: The feature is at the top edge.
top.md: The feature is at the top edge.
